name: Anonymous (Greek folk songs)
bio: The Greek folk songs (δημοτικά τραγούδια) were sung across the Greek-speaking world under Ottoman rule and after: klephtic ballads of the mountain fighters, laments, songs of exile and of love, and the older ballads of the Byzantine frontier and of the bridge of Arta.

They were handed down orally and first printed in the nineteenth century by Fauriel (1824–1825), Passow (1860) and others. The songs here follow the anthology of the folklorist Nikolaos Politis, Εκλογαί από τα τραγούδια του ελληνικού λαού (Athens, 1914), the standard school selection.
